summary.text: Jon Milligan is serving his third term in the Arkansas House, representing District 33, which includes portions of Craighead and Mississippi counties; the member page lists his address as Lake City.

paragraphs.text: The legislature lists his public service as including a term as Majority Party Whip.
For the 95th General Assembly he is vice chair of the House Public Transportation Committee.
